## Findings

At most 2, the driver choosing which. Each: what the numbers show · the figure that shows it ·
what it costs · the change proposed, or the price of leaving it. An empty section that says it
is empty is a result; write "None this period" rather than deleting the heading.

A finding MAY carry a candidate rule for published-voice, in this shape, and only when every
evidence line is a figure: line quoted verbatim from a committed collection file:

    Candidate rule: <one sentence, in the ruler's own register>
    Evidence: <figure: line(s), verbatim, n included>

A candidate is not a ruling. It reaches published-voice only if the owner rules on it.
Write both lines at column 0. The candidate then waits here, open, until /sprint-planning
writes a Ruled: line under it (skills/funnel-review/SKILL.md step 4).

## What I would leave alone

---

This rite returns no verdict and gates nothing. It produces observations for the owner and
nothing else — the same constraint `/sprint-review` carries, for the same reason: marketing
judgement has no ruler, and a gate with no ruler grades taste.
Nothing here files an Issue. Only the owner opens work.
